title: Coastline
description: Coastline is a collection of mods designed to improve exploration. Craft planes, sail ships, rest in hammocks, and more.
body:
# **Coastline** This is the modpack. To play, visit our [server page](https://modrinth.com/server/coastline). [](https://discord.gg/e5jzkAj9Ms) [](https://coastline.thrandos.com) The ultimate modpack for exploration, made to work seamlessly on the Coastline server. Coastline contains everything you'll need to travel great distances, conquer structures, and build a unique world around you. It provides a whole new take on the Minecraft experience. ## Requirements This modpack is built for version **1.21.1** and runs best on the latest version of **Java**. If you want to recieve regular updates, use the Modrinth launcher. The most recent version of this modpack is required to join our server.
What's included in this modpack? Notable mods include Xaero's Minimap, Small Ships, Immersive Aircraft, and Ewewukek's Musket Mod. This pack also contains a number of performance and shader mods to improve everyone's experience, regardless of system specs. For more information, check the versions tab.
